sum: VS MEDIA Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, operates a network of digital creators who create and upload content to social media platforms in Hong Kong and Taiwan. It provides marketing services for brands, including strategy development, creator selection, branding and messaging, content creation and distribution, social media amplification, social media engagement, and data insights and measurement; and creates and publishes content on social media platforms. The company also sells products directly to customers. It serves creators in lifestyle, travel, food, gaming, tourism, fast-moving consumer goods, and retail sectors. The company was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Singapore.
